channel.title: Sakri (Rafael) Koskimies
channel.description: Development notes, engineering writeups and published CVE advisories by Sakri (Rafael) Koskimies.

item.title: shieldbreak
item.description: I forgot the password to a ssh key. It was still loaded in the agent, so I pulled it back out of memory. Here is how.

item.title: CVE-2026-62062
item.description: CSRF in Elementor, which runs on over 10 million sites. One link opened by a logged-in user carries out any REST API action their account allows, up to creating a rogue admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-113813
item.description: Missing authorization in PayPlug for WooCommerce, a payment gateway on 4,000-plus stores. Anyone could read, change or delete orders without logging in.

item.title: CVE-2026-95526
item.description: Broken access control in BEAR, a bulk product editor for WooCommerce on 30,000-plus stores.

item.title: CVE-2026-66575
item.description: Unauthenticated insecure direct object reference in King Addons for Elementor, a plugin on 10,000-plus sites.

item.title: Masteriyo LMS
item.description: Arbitrary content deletion in Masteriyo, a course builder and learning management plugin on 6,000-plus sites.

item.title: CVE-2025-9427
item.description: Reflected XSS in the Lemonsoft WordPress add-on. Lemonsoft is a Finnish ERP company listed on Nasdaq First North in Helsinki.

item.title: CVE-2022-3246
item.description: SQL injection in Blog2Social, a plugin on 50,000-plus sites at the time.

item.title: CVE-2022-3494
item.description: SQL injection in Complianz, which ran on over a million sites.
